content.title: Club América v Cruz Azul today – where to watch live?
content.text: America Y Ya·11 April 2026Club América v Cruz Azul today – where to watch live?Club América hosts Cruz Azul today in the Matchday 14 clash of the Clausura 2026.Las Águilas return home after being away for nearly two years, and they will do so in the clásico against Cruz Azul, in a match that until a couple of weeks ago seemed to have a clear favorite, but now looks very evenly matched.OneFootball VideosAmérica has not had a good tournament at all, but comes in after earning a couple of draws on the road, while Cruz Azul has gone four matches without a win, with two consecutive losses.A few weeks ago, it was clear that Cruz Azul was the favorite for this match by a wide margin, but right now we cannot say the same, since their level has dropped a lot and although Las Águilas still have not shown their best form, they have proven that they have what it takes to compete.It will be a very interesting match, one that could begin to determine the spots in the playoffs, with an América side that absolutely needs the win to temporarily secure sixth place in the table; since a loss could even drop them as far as tenth place.The players ruled out for this match.Henry Martín Víctor DávilaKevin ÁlvarezLuis Ángel MalagónThe likely lineup for this clash.In goal will be Rodolfo Cota.In central defense we would see Sebastián Cáceres with Israel Reyes; at right back Aarón Mejía and on the left, Miguel Vázquez.In midfield, Jonathan dos Santos alongside Erick Sánchez and a little further ahead of them, Raphael Veiga.And in the attacking area, Brain Rodríguez on the left, Alejandro Zendejas on the right, and Patricio Salas as center forward.The kit Club América will wear.What time is the match and where can you watch it?The match will be played at 09:00 PM (Central Mexico time) and will be broadcast on Canal 5, TUDN, VIX Premium, and Layvtime. In the United States it will air on TUDN USA.This article was translated into English by Artificial Intelligence.
